title: cynoglossum officinale var. montanum
intro: Cynoglossum officinale var. montanum, commonly known as Mountain Hound's Tongue, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote coughing. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents present in Mountain Hound's Tongue include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
